name: Guardian genius crossword No 214
preamble: In 15 clues the wordplay (or a second definition) leads to a solution after someone has been 8, the definition for which has gone missing but turns up as a solution elsewhere. Letter counts for the 15 clues are for the solutions before 8; but in 10 cases the required grid entry is the solution after 8. All grid entries are normal words and phrases or, in one case, an acronym.
